papers.title_en: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
papers.authors: Rahul Sajnani, Diego Romeres, Mingyuan Zhang, Kai Gao, Carl Qi, Baichuan Huang, Srinath Sridhar, Dylan Randle, Lillian J. Ratliff, Jose Barreiros, Manikantan Nambi, Jeroen Vanbaar
papers.evidence: 统一学习视频、动作与语言以控制具身机器人
papers.tldr: 机器人需要把语言、视觉经验与动作统一起来，尤其要在操作中保留任务记忆；既有方案常把推理模型和动作模型分阶段运行。UniWALM以单一混合变换器同步学习并生成视频、动作和语言，生成的子任务及文本记忆会在后续步骤重新输入，形成无需外部规划器的记忆闭环，并用FMC训练动作轨迹恢复。该模型提升组合抓放与RMBench记忆任务表现，真实寻物成功率从11.1%升至61.1%。结果显示，联合语言生成可增强操作能力，并支持依赖记忆的具身行为。
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).

papers.title_en: Foundation4D: Towards a unified perception and reconstruction model for autonomous vehicles
papers.authors: NVIDIA, :, Sérgio Agostinho, Maximilian Apodaca, Emmanuel Attia, Guillem Braso, George Dong, Ilya Fedorov, Michele Fenzi, Gang Huang, Jiahui Huang, Shengyu Huang, Bingxin Ke, Laura Leal-Taixé, Kuan-Ting Lee, Mingxuan Liu, Tian Liu, Tim Meinhardt, Aljoša Ošep, Naveen Kumar Rai, Kefei Ren, Cristiano Saltori, Keqiang Wu, Ning Xu, Fei Xue, Jin-Bey Yu, Lei Zhang, Qunjie Zhou
papers.evidence: 前馈式三维几何估计与高斯场景重建模型
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶需要从多相机视频中同时理解场景几何、目标与语义占用，但现有方案常将感知和重建分开处理。Foundation4D以共享前馈模型统一几何估计、三维检测、语义占用和高斯重建，并通过因子化时空注意力融合跨相机、跨时刻信息。经基准微调后，它在Waymo和nuScenes深度评测中取得最低绝对相对误差，在nuScenes检测和OpenOccupancy占用评测中分别取得最高精度。论文还发布含1,253段驾驶视频的稠密标注基准，并证明联合训练有益于检测和几何估计，且可支持无激光雷达场景仿真重建。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Foundation4D, a unified feed-forward model for geometry estimation, 3D detection, semantic occupancy, and Gaussian reconstruction from multi-camera driving video. A shared backbone uses factorized spatiotemporal attention to efficiently combine observations across cameras and time. Our video inference pipeline uses pose graph optimization to refine camera trajectories and assembles object tracks across input windows. We also develop a data annotation pipeline and release PAI-Foundation4D, a benchmark with dense depth and semantic occupancy labels for 1,253 driving clips. With benchmark-specific fine-tuning, Foundation4D achieves the lowest depth AbsRel on Waymo and nuScenes, the highest detection mAP on nuScenes, and the highest occupancy mIoU on OpenOccupancy among the compared methods. Our task-combination study shows benefits for both detection and geometry: co-training detection with geometry and occupancy improves top-class mAP by 1.2 points over detection-only training, while co-training geometry with detection reduces camera-to-rig translation error by $13.4\%$ relative to geometry-only training. We further use the predicted geometry and trajectories as priors for lidarless NuRec, supporting reconstruction of driving scenes for simulation.

papers.title_en: OASIS: Online Anchor-centric Scene Inference System for Open-Vocabulary Retrieval and Navigation in Dynamic Environments
papers.authors: Kaiyao Liao, Qingfeng Li, Chen Chen, Xiaoze Wu, Qing Sun, Jianwei Niu
papers.evidence: 动态场景中的机器人建图、开放词汇检索与导航
papers.tldr: 动态真实环境中的机器人需要长期可靠建图、开放词汇检索与导航，但轻量地图语义不足，稠密地图成本较高且易受干扰，场景变化后也难以找回物体。OASIS以稳定语义锚点组织稀疏环境记忆，为锚点融合语义描述、视觉特征和几何状态，并按需提取证据、分层检索。系统还利用导航过程中积累的瞬时观测重新定位移动物体。仿真与真实环境实验覆盖标准检索及静态、动态导航，验证其复杂检索导航能力和场景变化后的物体重定位效果，为动态环境中的长期自主提供统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable robotic mapping in dynamic real-world environments is essential for embodied intelligence and long-term autonomy. However, existing methods often involve a trade-off: lightweight online mapping is efficient but captures limited semantic context, while dense mapping provides richer semantics at higher computational cost and is more vulnerable to distractors. They also struggle to relocalize objects after scene changes. To address these challenges, we propose the Online Anchor-centric Scene Inference System (OASIS), a unified system for online mapping, complex open-vocabulary retrieval, and navigation in dynamic environments. Motivated by the observation that indoor scenes are organized around stable semantic anchors, OASIS represents the environment using a sparse set of anchor nodes, each maintaining a unified multimodal representation that integrates semantic descriptions, visual features, and geometric states for reasoning, verification, and navigation. Its compact anchor-centric memory supports on-demand evidence extraction and hierarchical retrieval, reducing redundant storage while improving retrieval reliability. To handle scene dynamics, OASIS further reuses transient observations collected during navigation to relocalize moved objects. Experiments in both simulation and real-world environments, including standard retrieval benchmarks and navigation tasks under both static and dynamic settings, demonstrate that our system can perform complex open-vocabulary retrieval and navigation, while also enabling relocation of displaced objects after scene changes.

papers.title_en: IORA: Irregular Object Immobilization under Restricted Actuation
papers.authors: Sang-Hun Han, Changyeon Won, JunGyu Lee, Min-Gyu Park, Hae-Gon Jeon
papers.evidence: 直接解决机器人抓取与物体稳定操作
papers.tldr: 低自由度耦合手难以实现传统灵巧抓取所需的接触拓扑，而支撑面虽能提供稳定作用力，却常仅被视为几何约束。IORA面向不规则物体，将手部与物体局部表面建图并搜索运动学可行匹配，再优化腕部位姿和电机状态，并以物理仿真验证；还可按任务条件局部探索邻近抓取。多类物体实验显示方法获得较高成功率及较强抗扰动能力，真实烹饪场景也验证了抓取的可执行性。研究将支撑接触纳入低自由度抓取设计，为受限驱动下稳定固定物体提供实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Stable grasping under task-specific disturbances is important for robotic manipulation. However, most dexterous grasp synthesis methods are developed for highly actuated hands in free space, and low-DoF hands may not be able to realize the contact topologies required by these grasps. Meanwhile, support surfaces can provide useful contact forces, but are often treated only as geometric constraints. We present a support-aware grasp synthesis framework for object immobilization with low-DoF coupled hands. Given irregular object geometry, our method represents both hand and object local surface regions as graphs and searches for kinematically feasible matchings between them. We then refine the wrist pose and motor state for geometric contact feasibility and validates the refined grasps through physical rollouts. Starting from the validated grasp pose, an optional task-guided local search explores nearby grasp configurations by varying the wrist pose and motor state, and selects one according to the specified task condition. Experiments on diverse objects show that our method generates various grasp configurations that achieve high grasp success and strong disturbance resistance. Real-world experiments further demonstrate physically executable grasps which enable object immobilization in cooking scenario.

papers.title_en: Stream4D: Streaming 4D Reconstruction with Training-free Motion Decoupling via Causal KV-Cache Attention
papers.authors: Wei Zhang, Ying Feng, Mengtong Wu, Shiqiang Gong, Huaqi Zhang, Qi Zhang
papers.evidence: 将运动解耦直接集成到StreamVGGT等Transformer重建骨干
papers.tldr: 动态场景中的流式四维重建常把环境视为静态，动态物体会干扰相机位姿估计，造成长序列漂移与重影。Stream4D无需训练，利用因果注意力KV缓存中的跨层、跨时间运动线索，并结合深度先验生成动态掩码。再以软键屏蔽减少动态区域对注意力的干扰，在遮挡和无纹理区域也提升分离能力。实验显示其改善位姿估计与静态场景重建、产生可靠掩码并抑制重影，可直接接入现有流式架构。
papers.abstract_en: 4D scene reconstruction requires robust handling of dynamic objects, yet existing streaming methods commonly assume static scenes, leading to pose drift and ghosting artifacts over long sequences. We introduce Stream4D, a training-free, motion-decoupled streaming reconstruction framework that can be directly integrated into causal Transformer backbones (e.g., StreamVGGT, Stream3R). Our key observation is that causal attention implicitly encodes rich temporal motion cues within the KV cache. We adaptively aggregate these cues from multiple attention layers and across temporal windows, and fuse them with depth priors to handle challenging cases such as occlusions and textureless regions, producing precise dynamic masks that decouple static and dynamic regions. We then apply a soft key masking scheme that leverages these dynamic masks to suppress interference from dynamic regions in causal attention, thereby improving camera pose estimation accuracy. Stream4D inherits the efficiency of causal attention and remains compatible with existing streaming architectures. On diverse dynamic-scene benchmarks, Stream4D significantly improves camera pose estimation and static-scene reconstruction quality, yields reliable dynamic masks, and effectively mitigates long-sequence ghosting.

papers.title_en: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
papers.authors: Qi Lv, Jiayi Lin, Yuxin Jiang, Jianzong Wang, Xiang Deng, Mike Shou Zheng
papers.evidence: 通过机器人骨架监督学习环境随动作变化的世界模型
papers.tldr: 机器人世界模型需要根据动作预测环境变化，但从视频重建学习的潜在动作常混合机器人运动、物体响应及其他场景变化，难以对应真实控制。SkeLAM以机器人骨架监督拆分运动学潜在分量与保留视觉动态的残差，并通过跨模态交换重建促进表征互换。模型分路条件生成，动作适配器将机器人控制映射到运动学空间，分支丢弃降低对未来残差信息的依赖。在DROID上末端执行器ADE较DreamDojo下降19.5%、LPIPS下降11.1%，并显示运动专化、零样本人形迁移及成功率预测与实机执行一致，提升了生成的可控性。
papers.abstract_en: Robot world models simulate how environments evolve in response to robot actions. Latent action models enable learning dynamics from videos by encoding visual transitions as proxy actions. However, reconstruction-driven latent actions mix robot motion with object responses and other scene changes, complicating their correspondence with robot controls. We propose SkeLAM, a skeleton-guided latent action model for controllable robot world modeling. SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into a kinematic component grounded by robot skeleton supervision and a residual component retaining complementary visual dynamics. Cross-modal swap reconstruction encourages RGB-derived and skeleton-derived kinematic representations to be interchangeable during video reconstruction. The world model incorporates both components through separate conditioning pathways, while branch dropout reduces its dependence on future-derived residual information. A lightweight adapter maps robot actions to the kinematic space, and subsequent world-model fine-tuning adapts generation to these predicted conditions. At inference, the model generates future observations from the current observation and robot actions. On DROID, SkeLAM reduces end-effector ADE by 19.5% and LPIPS by 11.1% compared with DreamDojo. Motion probing supports kinematic specialization, while qualitative results demonstrate zero-shot human-to-robot motion transfer in generated rollouts. Policy evaluation shows agreement between predicted success rates and those measured in real robot executions.

papers.title_en: OmniRay: Camera-Agnostic Monocular 3D Reconstruction with Composite Ray Fields
papers.authors: Namitha Guruprasad, Abhay Yadav, Cheng Peng, Rama Chellappa, Anand Bhattad
papers.evidence: 前馈单目三维重建并改进相机几何建模
papers.tldr: 单目模型可由单张图像快速恢复三维，但针孔相机假设会使鱼眼与全景图像产生几何畸变。相机感知方法虽预测逐像素射线场，却往往用单一固定基底兼顾整体投影与局部变化，表达能力受限。OmniRay将射线几何按复杂度分层，以单调径向基底、球谐残差和自由形式残差依次组成球面旋转。模型无需推理时获得相机参数，即可逐像素预测射线方向和尺度不定的径向距离，并恢复点云；多种相机配置实验显示其达到新的最佳表现。
papers.abstract_en: Monocular models recover 3D geometry from a single image in one pass, but most assume a pinhole camera and produce distorted geometry on the wide-angle imagery produced by fisheye and panoramic lenses. Camera-aware models remove this assumption by predicting a per-pixel ray field. However, they represent different camera geometries using a single fixed basis to capture both the overall camera projection and its finer variations. We argue that camera geometry can be viewed as having a hierarchy of complexity for representing rays. We present OmniRay, a feed-forward model whose Ray Module is composed of three components: a monotone radial base that captures radially symmetric structure, a spherical-harmonic residual for smooth deviations from it, and a free-form residual for remaining local variation. These components are composed as successive rotations on the sphere, allowing the representation to accommodate diverse camera geometries. Given a single image, OmniRay predicts a ray direction and an up-to-scale radial distance for every pixel, from which a 3D point cloud is recovered without needing camera information at inference time. Extensive experiments across different camera configurations demonstrate that OmniRay establishes a new state-of-the-art in camera-agnostic monocular 3D reconstruction.

papers.title_en: PASS-VLN: Passability-Aware Local-Command Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Cong Zou, Xiangsheng Shi, Xuanhui Wang, Fubin Wang, Guangjun Ge, Chao Wang, Yu Wang
papers.evidence: 针对机器人身体约束评估局部导航的可通行性与无碰撞执行。
papers.tldr: 现有视觉语言导航基准通常假设指令均可执行，长程任务又混合了局部运动、规划与空间记忆，难以定位通行失败原因。PASS-VLN固定场景、指令、起点和参考路线，仅改变机器人宽度，要求可通行时到达目标、受阻时提前停止。模型以障碍膨胀编码机体宽度，融合局部几何、视觉和语言信息，并用离散动作码实现连续闭环控制。实验中，碰撞无关成功率较强基线提升约12个百分点，且能泛化到未见宽度；结合高层规划及真实部署也表现有效。该工作提供了针对身体约束下局部命令执行的基准与模型。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires not only understanding instructions but also determining whether and how a robot can physically execute them. However, existing VLN benchmarks typically assume executable instructions and focus on long-horizon tasks. This leaves body-dependent local execution, including passability and collision-free execution, largely unexamined. Evaluating these factors within long-horizon tasks would entangle local physical execution with task planning and long-term spatial memory, making navigation failures difficult to attribute. We therefore focus on grounding local navigation commands in executable motion under environmental and robot body constraints. We present PASS-VLN, a passability-aware local-command VLN benchmark and model. The benchmark holds the scene, instruction, start pose, and reference route fixed while varying robot body width, requiring target completion when the instructed passage is feasible and stopping before blockage otherwise. Our model encodes body width through obstacle inflation in a depth-derived local bird's-eye view, fuses geometry with visual and linguistic context, and predicts discrete latent action codes for continuous closed-loop execution. Experiments show that PASS-VLN improves collision-free success by approximately 12 percentage points over a strong VLN model fine-tuned on our benchmark, while adapting reach-versus-stop behavior to body constraints and generalizing to unseen body widths. When integrated with a high-level planner, PASS-VLN achieves higher success with fewer local commands, while real-world deployment further demonstrates its effectiveness as a low-level executor. The benchmark and model will be released.

papers.title_en: GeoMem-VLA: Internalizing 3D Scene Understanding into Temporal Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Qinfan Zhang, Yifan Luo, Haoyuan Shi, Guanlin Liu, Han Dong, Haozhe Shan, Yong Dai, Xiangcong Ren, Xiaozhu Ju
papers.evidence: 将三维几何理解编码为时序记忆，以支持机器人操作决策。
papers.tldr: 机器人操作需要理解三维几何，但多数视觉语言动作模型依赖当前二维观测；逐帧推断出的几何信息也往往没有累积成持续的任务表示。GeoMem-VLA通过几何流匹配训练专用几何令牌，并将其与观测记忆结合，持续检索、融合和保留关键历史信息。推理时模型无需调用三维教师或显式重建场景，便可依据历史与当前表征生成动作。其在LIBERO、RoboTwin及五项真实任务中分别取得98.9%、最高91.24%和78.0%的平均成功率，显示任务相关的三维记忆有助于机器人控制。
papers.abstract_en: Geometric structure is essential for robotic manipulation and understanding the 3D world. Most VLA models rely on 2D representations of current observations, while geometry-aware approaches often require additional 3D information. However, geometry inferred independently from individual observations is often discarded rather than accumulated into a persistent task representation. Our key insight is that action generation needs a compact, task-relevant geometric abstraction that can be continuously updated, rather than a complete, renderable 3D reconstruction at every step. We introduce GeoMem-VLA, a VLA framework that internalizes explicit 3D supervision into dedicated geometric tokens and maintains them as temporal memory for action generation, without directly aligning the VLM's native visual embeddings with the teacher feature space. During training, a frozen geometry foundation model supervises learnable GeoPlan tokens through a geometric flow-matching objective over the current scene point map and future end-effector tracks. These tokens are integrated with the memory of observation representations, where historical information is retrieved, adaptively fused with current observations, and consolidated to retain event frames as the task progresses. At inference, the policy retrieves historical representations and fuses them with the current working representation to predict actions, without invoking the 3D teacher or explicitly reconstructing the scene. After benchmark-specific downstream adaptation, GeoMem-VLA achieves 98.9% average success on LIBERO and 91.10% / 91.24% on RoboTwin's clean/randomized settings. Across five real-world tasks, GeoMem-VLA achieves 78.0% average success. These results suggest that internalizing and remembering 3D scene understanding is a promising approach to robot control.

papers.title_en: MixPT: Point Transformer with Interleaved Window and Global Attention
papers.authors: Minkyun Seo, Hyungtae Lim, Jaesik Park
papers.evidence: 点云变换器通过交错窗口和全局注意力建模三维场景几何
papers.tldr: 点云Transformer需要兼顾局部几何建模与场景范围内的跨区域信息交换。窗口注意力计算较省，但跨窗通信依赖窗口变化和层级池化；全局注意力可直接连接所有令牌，却在大规模场景中代价较高。MixPT交错使用窗口与全局注意力块，窗口块沿用固定序列化模式；令牌较多时，全局注意力作用于空间池化令牌，再将残差更新回传至原分辨率流。室内外基准显示，MixPT延迟低于代表性窗口及全局注意力基线，且准确率有竞争力；重复交错模块也展示了加深注意力阶段的可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Point cloud transformers aim to capture detailed local geometry and relationships across a scene at a manageable computational cost. Two common approaches are window attention and global attention. They differ in how they enable scene-wide interaction, which refers to information exchange among tokens across a scene. Window attention reduces computational cost by restricting self-attention to groups of tokens called windows; in serialized designs, each window contains a fixed number of consecutive tokens from a spatially ordered sequence. Because each block only directly connects tokens within the same window, information exchange across windows relies on changes in window membership across blocks and hierarchical pooling. Global attention, in contrast, directly connects all tokens within a scene, but computing attention over all token pairs can be costly when the number of tokens is large. To balance computational cost and scene-wide interaction, we introduce MixPT, a point transformer that uses a mix of window and global attention blocks in an interleaved schedule, while retaining a single fixed serialization pattern for its window blocks. For scenes with a large number of tokens, MixPT applies global attention to spatially pooled tokens and returns residual updates to the original-resolution stream. Across indoor and outdoor benchmarks, MixPT achieves competitive accuracy with lower latency than representative window and global attention baselines. We further demonstrate the feasibility of scaling the attention stage in depth by repeating the interleaved pattern of window and global attention blocks.

papers.title_en: Query-Time Calibration of CLIP Features for Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation
papers.authors: Dominik Engel, Yousef Rajeh, Leon Sick, Ivan Viola
papers.evidence: 直接研究三维场景语义分割与类别预测
papers.tldr: 开放词汇三维分割可将 CLIP 特征提升到三维高斯场景中，再按文本查询进行语义预测；但不同场景的视觉特征可能集中于共同方向，直接使用余弦相似度会忽略场景分布差异。本文提出无需重新训练或提取特征的查询时校准：对视觉特征与文本原型部分去除共享方向，并用通用参考词汇白化文本原型；多类预测采用软聚类，单查询预测采用 CSLS 与相关性边际。该方法在七种提升方式和四个数据集上稳定提高两类分割的平均交并比，说明针对场景调整特征比较可更有效利用既有表示。
papers.abstract_en: Lifting vision-language features such as CLIP into 3D Gaussian reconstructions enables open-vocabulary segmentation through natural-language queries. Although CLIP represents a broad range of semantic concepts, the lifted features of individual scenes can exhibit strong directional concentration, while raw cosine similarity does not account for the scene-specific feature distribution. We show that substantial segmentation gains can be obtained by changing how a fixed lifted feature field is compared with text. Our method partially subtracts a shared scene direction from visual features and text prototypes and whitens text prototypes using a fixed reference vocabulary of generic terms. It then uses soft clustering for multiclass prediction and CSLS with a relevance margin against the reference vocabulary for single-query prediction. Beyond reducing directional concentration, scene centering improves class-relative feature separation in every evaluated scene. Across seven lifting methods and four datasets, the resulting query-time calibration consistently improves mean intersection over union in both multiclass and single-query segmentation. These gains require no retraining, source-image re-encoding, or feature re-lifting, demonstrating the value of scene-conditioned comparison for making better use of existing lifted representations.

papers.title_en: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Jinyu Zhang, Haitao Lin, Jiashu Hou, Xiangyang Xue, Yanwei Fu
papers.evidence: 单次RGB-D前馈预测类别级物体位姿和三维形状
papers.tldr: 类别级RGB-D物体位姿估计无需实例专属模型，却要应对类别内形变、对称性和局部观测带来的歧义。F2G-Pose将视觉基础模型特征提升到点云，以局部几何编码和混合专家Transformer直接预测位姿、度量尺寸及相机坐标系补全形状。模型只需单次前向推理，在SOPE和ROPE上取得领先精度，位姿推理达到每秒28帧。其几何恢复、真实物体迁移与机器人操作结果表明，该方法有望兼顾效率和部署可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. To address this, we present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct, single-pass framework that predicts category-level pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape from a single RGB-D observation in one feed-forward pass. F2G-Pose lifts dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds, encodes local geometry with DGCNN tokenization, and integrates object-level structure with a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer. Joint size prediction and camera-frame shape completion encourage metric consistency through dense geometric supervision. With its task-specific network trained only on pose-annotated synthetic SOPE data and its frozen RADIO backbone externally pretrained, F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SOPE and ROPE while running at 28 FPS for pose-only inference, and further demonstrates strong camera-frame geometry on HouseCat6D and real-object transfer on HANDAL. Analyses of latency, robustness, shape completion, and GenPose++ candidate behavior further demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of F2G-Pose, with real-world manipulation experiments demonstrating deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs. The project page, code, and pretrained models are made available at https://jrryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/.

papers.title_en: CMAR-search: Commonsense and Memory Augmented Reasoning for Object Search in Dynamic Interactive Environments
papers.authors: Kaiyao Liao, Qingfeng Li, Xinlei Zhang, Chen Chen, Qing Sun, Jianwei Niu
papers.evidence: 利用记忆推理理解环境功能区域并执行交互式物体搜索。
papers.tldr: 在大型、动态且可交互的人类环境中寻找物体，现有方法因场景表示粗糙、缺少功能区域理解，往往只能低效地逐处探索，也难适应物体搬移。CMAR-search融合常识、环境记忆与实时感知，构建包含功能区域及其容器的功能三维场景图，并在区域和容器两个层级规划搜索。系统还可结合新观测动态重新定位物体。仿真和真实环境实验显示，该方法在成功率与搜索效率上显著优于先进基线，为复杂动态场景中的高效对象搜索提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic interactive object search in large-scale human environments presents substantial challenges for existing methods. Current scene representations like 3D Scene Graphs (3DSG) only provide coarse-grained spatial segmentation and cannot identify functional areas such as storage or leisure areas. Without functional area understanding, existing methods are constrained to exhaustive sequential exploration at large scales, resulting in inefficient search behaviors -- particularly in open-layout environments with numerous interactive objects such as drawers and cabinets. Moreover, these methods lack adaptability to environmental dynamics such as object relocations. To address these limitations, this paper proposes CMAR-search, a novel framework built upon Commonsense and Memory Augmented Reasoning (CMAR). Our approach leverages commonsense about area functionalities and aggregates environmental memory to construct a Functional 3D Scene Graph (F3DSG), which organizes the environment into functional areas with their associated containers. Through this structured representation, CMAR enables hierarchical action planning at both macro-area and micro-container levels, empowering the system to efficiently identify and inspect semantically relevant areas for effective object search. Notably, CMAR continuously integrates real-time perception, accumulated memory, and commonsense to dynamically relocalize objects in changing environments. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that CMAR-search significantly surpasses state-of-the-art baselines in both success rate and search efficiency for object search in dynamic interactive environments.

papers.title_en: RaSFNet: Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network for LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Chuang Chen
papers.evidence: 面向机器人与自动驾驶的激光雷达点云语义分割
papers.tldr: 基于投影的激光雷达点云分割虽便于使用二维网络提取特征，却会掩盖视锥内几何差异，也难以建模跨扫描区域关系；投影邻近还可能导致三维错配及不同量程特征混合。RaSFNet结合点云几何与激光雷达扫描特性，提出射线对齐几何分布编码、扫描拓扑感知的长程建模模块，以及以共享量程约束点与视锥特征交互的融合机制。在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes验证集上，模型分别取得70.2%和77.7%的mIoU。结果表明，将射线几何、扫描拓扑与量程对应关系纳入投影式分割，可提升语义判别并获得有竞争力的表现。
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation is a fundamental component of 3D perception for autonomous driving and robotics. Projection-based methods map 3D point clouds into 2D representations for feature extraction using 2D networks. However, aggregating multiple points during projection can obscure geometric differences within each frustum, while local feature extraction limits the modeling of spatial relationships across scanning regions. Moreover, proximity in the projected representation does not necessarily imply proximity in 3D space, and interactions between point and projected features may mix features from different ranges, reducing semantic discriminability. To address these challenges, we propose the Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network (RaSFNet), which incorporates point cloud geometry and LiDAR scanning characteristics into projection-based semantic segmentation. Specifically, the Ray-Aligned Geometric Distribution Encoding (RAGDE) module characterizes point distributions within each frustum using a ray-aligned coordinate system. To model spatial context, a Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba (STAM) block organizes frustum features according to the LiDAR azimuth sampling pattern and captures long-range dependencies across scanning regions. In addition, a Range-Constrained Point-Frustum Fusion (RCPFF) mechanism uses shared range information to guide feature exchange between point and frustum representations while maintaining spatial correspondence. RaSFNet achieves mIoU scores of 70.2% and 77.7% on the SemanticKITTI and nuScenes validation sets, respectively, indicating competitive segmentation performance compared with the evaluated methods.

papers.title_en: RecallGS: Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Thanh-Khoi Nguyen, Thien-Phuc Tran, Minh-Triet Tran
papers.evidence: 在线三维高斯场景中融合语义与几何，支持多视角三维场景理解
papers.tldr: 在线语义高斯泼溅可从连续图像中进行开放词汇三维场景理解，但图像语义特征缺少几何上下文，现有方法通常依赖额外训练的三维网络，增加训练和运行开销。RecallGS提出轻量、免训练的历史观测回忆机制，将过往视图作为非参数几何—语义先验。它用CLIP检索相关观测，通过透明度合成权重确定几何支持视角，并在高斯投影足迹上融合语义特征。在ScanNet和ScanNet++上，该方法取得较强语义分割表现，速度达2.48帧每秒。结果表明，观测历史能够有效补足几何语义信息，无须新增学习分支。
papers.abstract_en: Online semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables open-vocabulary scene understanding from streaming observations. However, existing methods recover geometric context missing from image-derived semantic features using an additionally learned 3D network, incurring extra training and runtime overhead. We observe that such geometric-semantic evidence may already exist in the agent's observation history and can be retrieved rather than learned. Based on this insight, we introduce RecallGS (Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting), a lightweight, training-free mechanism that treats past observations as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior. RecallGS follows a recall-ground-fuse pipeline: CLIP retrieves relevant observations, alpha-compositing weights identify geometrically supported views, and aggregate their semantic features over each Gaussian's rendered footprint. On ScanNet and ScanNet++, RecallGS achieves strong semantic segmentation performance at 2.48 FPS, demonstrating that geometric-semantic context can be effectively recovered from observation history without an additional learned 3D branch.

papers.title_en: GelSlim 5.0: Unifying Vision and Touch with a Single Fingertip Camera
papers.authors: Xiangdong Wang, I-Hsuan Huang, Xiaohao Xu, Xili Yi, Nima Fazeli, Xiaonan Huang
papers.evidence: 机器人指尖融合视觉与触觉，估计物体姿态和接触几何
papers.tldr: 物体操作中，外部视觉常被接触遮挡，而视觉与触觉分别擅长全局位姿和局部几何，多相机融合还需外参标定。GelSlim 5.0以单个固定指尖相机配合连续紫外响应接触层，通过切换照明依次采集透膜视觉图像与触觉图像。VisTacFusion采用非对称瓶颈融合，并支持双模态或单模态推理。在12种已知物体的真实验证中，双模态相较触觉单模态使深度均方误差、角度误差和位移L1分别降低61.2%、72.3%和61.3%，体现统一视点融合的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Vision and touch provide complementary cues for object pose and local contact geometry, but external cameras are often occluded at the contact site. We present GelSlim 5.0, a fingertip sensor that acquires visual and tactile observations with one fixed camera and a continuous UV-responsive contact layer. By switching illumination, the camera sequentially acquires through-membrane visual images and contact-sensitive tactile images from a shared viewpoint, avoiding inter-camera extrinsic calibration. To combine these observations, we introduce VisTacFusion, a multimodal transformer with separate prediction paths for planar object pose and contact geometry. Asymmetric bottleneck fusion incorporates visual context while preserving tactile spatial features for depth and surface-normal estimation. Modality dropout enables inference with paired inputs or either modality alone. On real validation data from 12 known objects, paired inputs reduce depth MSE, angular error, and translation $L_1$ by 61.2%, 72.3%, and 61.3%, respectively, relative to tactile-only inference with the same model. Relative to visual-only inference, the corresponding reductions are 93.7%, 6.1%, and 8.6%.

papers.title_en: A Unified Framework for Image-to-3D Part Generation via Variable Granularity
papers.authors: Qiwen Gu, Xin Zhou, Xiwu Chen, Zhongyang Zhu, Zhuo Zhang, Junqiao Zhao
papers.evidence: 融合不同粒度的几何条件进行三维部件生成
papers.tldr: 可控三维部件生成需要适配从粗略定位到精细轮廓等不同控制需求，但现有方法往往难以在单一框架中灵活处理多种几何条件。FlexPart 将稀疏点、密集包围盒和掩码等输入统一接入图像到三维部件生成模型，并结合门控自适应调制与非对称几何引导，促进跨粒度表示对齐和几何一致性。在 PartVerseXL 的掩码条件下，其部件 CD 较 TripoSG + SAM3D 低 16.6%，较 OmniPart 低 10.5%，整体网格质量也保持竞争力。该框架为不同控制粒度下的部件生成提供了统一且灵活的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Controllable 3D part generation is pivotal for digital asset creation, yet existing methods lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse user workflows requiring varying levels of control. In this paper, we introduce FlexPart, a unified image-to-3D part generation framework that supports variable-granularity geometric conditions within a single model. By seamlessly integrating heterogeneous inputs, ranging from sparse points to dense bounding boxes and masks, via gated adaptive modulation, FlexPart unlocks a powerful cross-modal synergy. We also propose an asymmetric geometric guidance mechanism that leverages strong spatial priors to align representations across granularities, improving geometric consistency and facilitating inter-task synergy. Under mask conditioning on PartVerseXL, FlexPart reduces Part CD by 16.6% relative to TripoSG + SAM3D and by 10.5% relative to OmniPart, while maintaining competitive whole-mesh quality. The code can be found at https://github.com/Gucci233/FlexPart

papers.title_en: EgoRayFormer: Ray-Space Stereo Refinement for Egocentric 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Haozhe Wang, Songyuan Wu, Jihai Xu, Jie Zhao
papers.evidence: 通过射线空间几何约束融合双目图像，间接关联三维几何视觉
papers.tldr: 头戴式鱼眼双目相机虽便于观察穿戴者身体，但畸变、遮挡和短基线使3D姿态估计困难，且既有方法常在两视图独立采样特征。EgoRayFormer围绕关节视线构造共享3D假设，在双目图像中联合采样并校正射线，再融合几何交会与学习式姿态更新。设备相对测试的三种子平均MPJPE在UnrealEgo2为17.64毫米、UnrealEgo-RW为49.55毫米，前者预训练可将RW结果降至47.57毫米。消融显示几何分支在两种输入分辨率下均有帮助，表明显式射线约束能提升精度，并适应深度约束较弱的情况。
papers.abstract_en: Head-mounted stereo fisheye cameras provide a compact view of the wearer's body, but strong distortion, partial visibility and a short baseline make 3D pose estimation difficult. Existing refinement decoders sample image features independently in each view, without requiring the samples to correspond to a common 3D hypothesis. We introduce EgoRayFormer, a causal pose estimator that couples stereo feature sampling and geometric refinement in ray space. For each joint, the decoder projects shared 3D hypotheses along and around its viewing ray into both images. A geometric branch then corrects the projected joint locations and intersects the resulting rays; a learned gate blends this geometric estimate with a learned pose update. This formulation introduces an explicit stereo constraint while retaining flexibility when the rays provide weak depth constraints. In local evaluations on the official device-relative test splits, EgoRayFormer achieves three-seed mean MPJPEs of 17.64 mm on UnrealEgo2 and 49.55 mm on UnrealEgo-RW, improving to 47.57 mm with UnrealEgo2 pre-training. In paired validation ablations, removing the geometric branch increases MPJPE in all three seeds at both input resolutions. With a common ResNet-18 encoder and input resolution, our system reduces RW test MPJPE by 9.09 mm relative to the device-relative EgoPoseFormer baseline. A separate protocol analysis quantifies the difference between device-relative and oracle-root evaluation.

papers.title_en: Differentiable Task-Driven Coded Aperture Camera Design with 3D Gaussian Scene Representations
papers.authors: Chengyang Yan, Donald G. Dansereau
papers.evidence: 联合设计相机与深度感知任务，涉及图像深度估计
papers.tldr: 相机成像设计直接影响感知任务表现，但传统方案多由专家分离调试，成本高且难以针对下游任务优化。本文提出可微联合设计框架，利用真实场景重建的三维高斯泼溅实现可微成像，并以梯度优化孔径掩模、相机参数和深度网络。框架用于设计单目与双目编码孔径散焦深度相机，结果优于已有编码孔径设计及非可微相机设计基线。研究为复杂相机系统的自动化、任务驱动设计提供了新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Camera design heavily influences perception task performance, yet cameras are typically designed by domain experts through costly experimentation, in isolation from the tasks they serve. Existing joint-design methods either rely on differentiable simulation limited to pre-captured 2D images, restricting them to optics or image-processing pipeline design, or use non-differentiable camera simulators optimised with derivative-free or reinforcement-learning methods that scale poorly with the number of design parameters. We present a differentiable framework for jointly designing complex camera systems and downstream perception tasks. We use it to design two coded-aperture depth-from-defocus cameras, a monocular and a stereo configuration, by jointly optimising the coded aperture mask, camera parameters, and a depth estimation network end-to-end. Our framework represents scenes with 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructed from real-world captures, providing a differentiable image formation process for gradient-based optimisation over design spaces intractable for prior differentiable approaches. Results demonstrate that our differentiable method improves over existing coded aperture design and non-differentiable camera design baselines, offering a step forward in automated and principled camera design for autonomous systems.

papers.title_en: A2I-Calib++: A Kinematics-Driven Anti-noise Active Calibration Framework for Whole-Body Multi-IMU Systems on Legged Robots
papers.authors: Fangyu Jiang, Chaoran Xiong, Kehui Ma, Zhen Sun, Zeyu Zhang, Ling Pei
papers.evidence: 面向腿式机器人多IMU融合的运动感知与传感器标定
papers.tldr: 腿式机器人多惯导融合有助于提升里程计鲁棒性，但标定需要充分运动激励，日常行走往往不足，足端滑移、冲击和振动还会干扰测量。A2I-Calib++利用机器人运动学，先搜索传感器时间偏差，再解析估计外参与惯性偏置；并以抗噪激励轨迹、接触感知控制和接触约束虚拟惯导构成完整流程。仿真和四足平台实验显示，该方法降低噪声敏感性与仿真标定误差，实现可重复的实机标定并提升里程计精度。它为腿式机器人多惯导系统提供了无需人工标定靶标的主动标定方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recently, multi-node inertial measurement unit (multi-IMU) systems have shown promise for robust odometry in legged robots. Multi-IMU fusion can improve legged robot odometry but requires accurate spatiotemporal calibration among the sensors. Existing multi-IMU calibration methods, designed for aerial or handheld platforms, face challenges on legged robots because routine locomotion may provide insufficient excitation, while foot slips, impacts, and vibrations introduce measurement disturbances. To address these challenges, we propose A2I-Calib++, a kinematics-driven anti-noise active calibration framework for body-mounted IMUs covered by the robot kinematic model. It estimates temporal offsets, extrinsic rotations and translations, and inertial biases through temporal correlation search followed by analytic spatial and bias estimation, without artificial calibration targets or complex parameter tuning for the target IMU. A2I-Calib++ comprises three core modules: 1) a Noise-Isotropy-Inspired Trajectory supported by a finite-horizon conditioning proposition that generates sufficient excitation to limit noise sensitivity; 2) a constraint-aware Adversarial Motion Priors controller that combines the anti-noise excitation with a rolling-contact reward for contact-aware execution; and 3) a contact-constrained virtual IMU that fuses pre-calibrated calf IMUs and joint kinematics under a rolling-contact model to construct the calibration reference. Furthermore, evaluations on both simulation and real-world quadruped platforms demonstrate notably reduced noise sensitivity and simulation calibration errors compared to conventional methods, together with repeatable real-world calibration and improved proprioceptive odometry accuracy for legged robots.

papers.title_en: MVLoMa: Multi-View Local Feature Matching with Any Geometry Foundation Model
papers.authors: Xinyang Lu, Shengzhe Wei, Sheng Tang, Weiqi Zhang, Juntong Fang, Zesong Li
papers.evidence: 多视图几何上下文增强局部匹配并支持视觉定位
papers.tldr: 结构-from-motion与视觉定位常需将参考图匹配多个邻图，逐对处理会重复计算，也难以利用多视图几何证据。MVLoMa将LoMa扩展为稀疏星形图匹配器，借助冻结几何模型增强局部描述子，并在一次前向过程中联合匹配中心图与所有邻图。它在四个数据集的25视图星形图上取得三档最佳相对位姿AUC宏平均（58.65/85.41/90.99），速度较逐边推理快2.20倍。结果表明，多视图上下文、可见性筛选与几何监督有助于兼顾匹配精度和效率，且方案支持多种几何编码器。
papers.abstract_en: Local feature matching is typically formulated for image pairs, although structure-from-motion and visual localization commonly match one reference image against many retrieved or covisible neighbours. Applying a pairwise matcher independently to these centre-neighbour edges duplicates reference-side computation and prevents the matcher from exploiting complementary multi-view geometric evidence from the remaining observations. To address these limitations, we introduce MVLoMa, a sparse star-graph matcher that extends LoMa from image pairs to multiple views. MVLoMa first uses a frozen multi-view geometry model to jointly describe all images in a star, then injects the resulting cross-view geometric context into local descriptors. It then matches the centre image to all neighbours in a single forward pass through per-view self-attention and bidirectional centre-neighbour cross-attention. For supervision, we derive positive correspondences only from depth-valid, mutually visible dense warps and explicitly penalize high-confidence matches that violate epipolar geometry. On 25-view star graphs from HyperSim, ScanNet++, Mip-NeRF 360, and Tanks and Temples, MVLoMa obtains the best macro-average relative-pose AUC among the compared methods at all three thresholds (58.65/85.41/90.99). Its matcher is 2.20 times faster than sequential evaluation of the 24 centre-neighbour edges. The same design supports four tested frozen geometry encoders -- DA3, $π^3$, VGGT, and VGGT-$Ω$ -- with DA3-Giant performing best on all reported encoder-ablation metrics. Controlled ablations further isolate the effects of geometry-aware descriptors, visibility filtering, geometric negative supervision, and joint multi-view inference.
